messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] Mantel test (using prorustes/mahalanibis and haplotypes)
parts:
Following the code I sent, there is an object in the ‘Results’ list called   ‘$prodD’, which contains a triangular matrix of Procrustes distances between all pairs of individuals.

 

Below is an example using a geomorph dataset:

 

library(geomorph)

data(plethodon)

res <- gpagen(A = plethodon$land, verbose = TRUE)

res$procD

Dean

parts:
Shadia,

 

There are many ways to calculate the matrix of Procrustes distances. The code I provided you earlier accomplished it using arguments within geomorph.

 

If you want a step-by-step approach, here is one:

 

library(geomorph)

data(plethodon)

Y.gpa <- gpagen(plethodon$land)

shape <- two.d.array(Y.gpa$coords)

Pdistances <- dist(shape) # a lower-triangular matrix of pairwise Procrustes distances

Dean
